source.text: הֲלֹֽא־חָכְמָ֥ה תִקְרָ֑א וּ֝תְבוּנָ֗ה תִּתֵּ֥ן קוֹלָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Does not wisdom call, and understanding give her voice?

en.L: Does not wisdom call out, \q and understanding give her voice?
en.B: Listen! Is that not Wisdom calling, \q Understanding raising her voice?
en.R: Wisdom is calling out. \q Understanding is shouting for people to hear.

fr.L: La sagesse n’appelle-t-elle pas, \q et l’intelligence ne donne-t-elle pas de sa voix ?
fr.B: Écoutez ! N’est-ce pas la Sagesse qui appelle, \q l’Intelligence qui élève la voix ?
fr.R: La sagesse appelle. \q L’intelligence crie pour que les gens l’entendent.

sw.L: Je, hekima haiti, \q na ufahamu hautoi sauti yake?
sw.B: Sikilizeni! Je, si Hekima anayeita, \q na Ufahamu anayepaza sauti yake?
sw.R: Hekima anaita kwa sauti. \q Ufahamu anapiga kelele ili watu wasikie.

decisions.choice: does not wisdom call? a question that means "she does"
decisions.reason: The question sets Wisdom's open call against the secret whisper of the woman in chapter 7.

decisions.choice: Wisdom calls: as in 1:20–33
decisions.reason: Wisdom speaks in person for the second time. Her first speech warned; this one invites.

decisions.choice: "la Sagesse", "l'Intelligence" with capitals at Balanced where the English Balanced names them as persons (8:1, 8:12, 8:14)
decisions.reason: The English Balanced capitalises Wisdom where she speaks as a person; French follows it so that the levels show the same reading. Literal and Readable keep lowercase, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Wisdom and Understanding take personal agreement at Balanced and Readable ("anayeita", "anaita"), as in 1:20; Literal keeps the plain class 9 and 11 agreement of the question
decisions.reason: Chapter 8 is Wisdom speaking as a person. Literal follows the Hebrew question word for word with the nouns' own agreement; the other levels let her speak as a person, which Swahili marks by agreement, not by gender.

source.text: בְּרֹאשׁ־מְרוֹמִ֥ים עֲלֵי־דָ֑רֶךְ בֵּ֖ית נְתִיב֣וֹת נִצָּֽבָה׃

records.literal_gloss: At [the] top of heights, on [the] way, between paths, she stations herself.

en.L: At [the] top of [the] heights, beside [the] way, \q where [the] paths meet, she takes her stand;
en.B: On the high places by the road, \q where the paths cross, she takes her stand;
en.R: She stands on the hilltops beside the road, \q where the paths meet.

fr.L: Au sommet des hauteurs, au bord du chemin, \q là où se croisent les sentiers, elle se tient debout ;
fr.B: Sur les hauteurs, au bord de la route, \q au carrefour des sentiers, elle se poste ;
fr.R: Elle se tient sur les collines, au bord de la route, \q là où les chemins se croisent.

sw.L: Juu ya vilele vya mahali palipoinuka, kando ya njia, \q mahali mapito yakutanapo, husimama;
sw.B: Juu ya mahali palipoinuka kando ya barabara, \q mahali njia zinapokutana, anasimama;
sw.R: Anasimama juu ya vilima kando ya barabara, \q mahali njia zinapokutana.

decisions.choice: between paths: at the crossroads
decisions.reason: "The house of the paths" is where roads meet, where most travelers pass.

source.text: לְיַד־שְׁעָרִ֥ים לְפִי־קָ֑רֶת מְב֖וֹא פְתָחִ֣ים תָּרֹֽנָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: At [the] side of [the] gates, at [the] mouth of [the] town, [at the] entrance of [the] doors she cries aloud:

en.L: beside [the] gates at [the] mouth of [the] town, \q at [the] entrance of [the] doorways she cries aloud:
en.B: beside the gates where the town is entered, \q at the doorways, she calls aloud:
en.R: She shouts beside the city gates, \q where people go in and out:

fr.L: à côté des portes, à l’entrée de la ville, \q à l’entrée des portails elle crie à haute voix :
fr.B: à côté des portes par où l’on entre dans la ville, \q à l’entrée des maisons, elle appelle à haute voix :
fr.R: Elle crie à côté des portes de la ville, \q là où les gens entrent et sortent :

sw.L: kando ya malango kwenye mwingilio wa mji, \q kwenye maingilio ya milango hulia kwa sauti kuu:
sw.B: kando ya malango mahali watu wanapoingia mjini, \q kwenye milango, anaita kwa sauti kuu:
sw.R: Anapiga kelele kando ya malango ya mji, \q mahali watu wanapoingia na kutoka:

decisions.choice: the gates ... the doorways: the town's public places
decisions.reason: As in 1:21: where business, courts and travelers meet.

source.text: אֲלֵיכֶ֣ם אִישִׁ֣ים אֶקְרָ֑א וְ֝קוֹלִ֗י אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: To you, men, I call, and my voice [is] to [the] sons of humankind.

en.L: "To you, {{gender:people|men}}, I call, \q and my voice [is] to [the] {{gender:children|sons}} of humankind.
en.B: "To you, all people, I am calling; \q my voice goes out to everyone on earth.
en.R: "I am calling out to all of you. \q I am speaking to everyone.

fr.L: « C’est vous, {{gender:humains|hommes}}, que j’appelle, \q et ma voix [va] aux {{gender:enfants|fils}} de l’humanité.
fr.B: « C’est vous tous, les humains, que j’appelle ; \q ma voix s’adresse à tous les habitants de la terre.
fr.R: « C’est vous tous que j’appelle. \q Je parle à tout le monde.

sw.L: "Kwenu, enyi watu, ninaita, \q na sauti yangu [ni] kwa wanadamu.
sw.B: "Ninawaita ninyi, watu wote; \q sauti yangu inawafikia wote walio duniani.
sw.R: "Ninawaita ninyi nyote. \q Ninasema na kila mtu.

decisions.choice: men ... the sons of humankind: all people
decisions.reason: Both phrases (ishim, bene adam) mean people in general. Wisdom calls to everyone, not to one young man (compare 8:31).

decisions.choice: gender spans on the nouns: "humains" or "hommes", "enfants" or "fils"
decisions.reason: Both Hebrew words mean all people (meaning decision m1). French has to choose between an inclusive noun and the traditional "hommes", "fils", so the setting goes on the nouns, as the English has it.

decisions.choice: "watu" and "wanadamu" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Watu" and "wanadamu" already mean all people; "wanaume" would mean men only, so Swahili has nothing for the gender setting to switch.

source.text: הָבִ֣ינוּ פְתָאיִ֣ם עָרְמָ֑ה וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים הָבִ֥ינוּ לֵֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: Understand, simple ones, prudence, and fools, understand heart.

en.L: Understand prudence, simple ones; \q and fools, understand heart.
en.B: You who are naive, learn to be shrewd; \q you fools, get some sense.
en.R: You people who believe anything, learn to be wise. \q You fools, learn to think.

fr.L: Comprenez la prudence, simples ; \q et insensés, comprenez [ce qu’est] le cœur.
fr.B: Vous les naïfs, apprenez à être avisés ; \q vous les insensés, acquérez du bon sens.
fr.R: Vous qui vous laissez tromper, apprenez à être sages. \q Vous les insensés, apprenez à réfléchir.

sw.L: Fahamuni werevu, enyi wajinga; \q na ninyi wapumbavu, fahamuni moyo.
sw.B: Enyi wajinga, jifunzeni kuwa werevu; \q ninyi wapumbavu, pateni akili.
sw.R: Ninyi watu mnaodanganywa kwa urahisi, jifunzeni kuwa na hekima. \q Ninyi wapumbavu, jifunzeni kufikiri.

decisions.choice: understand heart: gain sense
decisions.reason: The heart is the mind (2:2); "understand heart" is to come to one's senses.

decisions.choice: simple ones ... prudence: the purpose of 1:4
decisions.reason: Wisdom offers what the book promised in 1:4: prudence for the simple.

source.text: שִׁ֭מְעוּ כִּֽי־נְגִידִ֣ים אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וּמִפְתַּ֥ח שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י מֵישָׁרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Listen, for princely things I will speak, and [the] opening of my lips [will be] right things.

en.L: Listen, for noble things I will speak, \q and [the] opening of my lips [will be] upright things.
en.B: Listen, for what I say is worthy of a prince, \q and right is what my lips bring out.
en.R: Listen to me, because what I say is important. \q What I say is right.

fr.L: Écoutez, car je dirai des choses nobles, \q et l’ouverture de mes lèvres [sera] des choses droites.
fr.B: Écoutez, car mes paroles sont dignes d’un prince, \q et ce qui sort de mes lèvres est droit.
fr.R: Écoutez-moi, parce que ce que je dis est important. \q Ce que je dis est juste.

sw.L: Sikilizeni, kwa maana nitasema mambo ya kifalme, \q na kufunguka kwa midomo yangu [kutakuwa] mambo ya unyofu.
sw.B: Sikilizeni, kwa maana ninayosema yanamfaa mkuu, \q na midomo yangu hutoa yaliyo sawa.
sw.R: Nisikilizeni, kwa sababu ninayosema ni muhimu. \q Ninayosema ni sawa.

decisions.choice: noble things: words fit for a ruler
decisions.reason: The word (negidim) is related to the word for a ruler or prince (nagid).

source.text: כִּֽי־אֱ֭מֶת יֶהְגֶּ֣ה חִכִּ֑י וְתוֹעֲבַ֖ת שְׂפָתַ֣י רֶֽשַׁע׃

records.literal_gloss: For truth my palate will utter, and an abomination of my lips [is] wickedness.

en.L: For my palate will utter truth, \q and wickedness [is] an abomination to my lips.
en.B: For my mouth speaks the truth; \q my lips cannot stand wickedness.
en.R: I always tell the truth. \q I hate to say anything evil.

fr.L: Car mon palais prononcera la vérité, \q et la méchanceté [est] une abomination pour mes lèvres.
fr.B: Car ma bouche dit la vérité ; \q mes lèvres ont horreur de la méchanceté.
fr.R: Je dis toujours la vérité. \q Je déteste dire quoi que ce soit de mal.

sw.L: Kwa maana kinywa changu kitanena kweli, \q na uovu [ni] chukizo kwa midomo yangu.
sw.B: Kwa maana kinywa changu husema kweli; \q midomo yangu haiwezi kuvumilia uovu.
sw.R: Siku zote mimi husema kweli. \q Ninachukia kusema jambo lolote ovu.

decisions.choice: utter: murmur, speak thoughtfully
decisions.reason: The verb (hagah) is used of meditating aloud (Psalm 1:2).

source.text: בְּצֶ֥דֶק כָּל־אִמְרֵי־פִ֑י אֵ֥ין בָּ֝הֶ֗ם נִפְתָּ֥ל וְעִקֵּֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: In righteousness [are] all [the] words of my mouth; there is not in them a twisted or crooked [thing].

en.L: All [the] words of my mouth [are] in righteousness; \q there is nothing in them twisted or crooked.
en.B: Every word from my mouth is right; \q there is nothing twisted or crooked in any of them.
en.R: Everything I say is right. \q None of my words are twisted or false.

fr.L: Toutes les paroles de ma bouche [sont] dans la justice ; \q il n’y a en elles rien de tordu ni de tortueux.
fr.B: Toutes les paroles de ma bouche sont justes ; \q aucune n’a rien de tordu ni de tortueux.
fr.R: Tout ce que je dis est juste. \q Aucune de mes paroles n’est tordue ou fausse.

sw.L: Maneno yote ya kinywa changu [ni] katika haki; \q hakuna ndani yake kilichopindika wala kilichopotoka.
sw.B: Kila neno la kinywa changu ni la haki; \q hakuna lililopindika wala lililopotoka hata moja.
sw.R: Kila ninachosema ni sawa. \q Hakuna neno langu lililopotoka wala la uongo.

decisions.choice: twisted or crooked
decisions.reason: Two words for what is bent (8:8; 2:15). Wisdom's words are the opposite of the troublemaker's (6:12).

source.text: כֻּלָּ֣ם נְ֭כֹחִים לַמֵּבִ֑ין וִֽ֝ישָׁרִ֗ים לְמֹ֣צְאֵי דָֽעַת׃

records.literal_gloss: All of them [are] straight to [the one] understanding, and right to those finding knowledge.

en.L: All of them [are] straight to the one who understands, \q and right to those who find knowledge.
en.B: They are all plain to anyone with understanding, \q and right to those who have found knowledge.
en.R: People who understand know that what I say is true. \q People who have learned know it is right.

fr.L: Toutes [sont] droites pour celui qui comprend, \q et justes pour ceux qui trouvent la connaissance.
fr.B: Elles sont toutes claires pour qui a de l’intelligence, \q et justes pour ceux qui ont trouvé la connaissance.
fr.R: Les gens qui comprennent savent que ce que je dis est vrai. \q Ceux qui ont appris savent que c’est juste.

sw.L: Yote [ni] wazi kwa yule afahamuye, \q na sawa kwa wale wapatao maarifa.
sw.B: Yote ni wazi kwa kila mwenye ufahamu, \q na sawa kwa wale waliopata maarifa.
sw.R: Watu wenye ufahamu wanajua kwamba ninayosema ni kweli. \q Watu waliojifunza wanajua ni sawa.

decisions.choice: straight: plain, clear
decisions.reason: The word (nekohim) means straight ahead, clear to see. Wisdom is not hidden from those who seek her.

source.text: קְחֽוּ־מוּסָרִ֥י וְאַל־כָּ֑סֶף וְ֝דַ֗עַת מֵחָר֥וּץ נִבְחָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Take my discipline and not silver, and knowledge rather than gold chosen.

en.L: Take my discipline and not silver, \q and knowledge rather than choice gold.
en.B: Choose my discipline instead of silver, \q and knowledge over the finest gold.
en.R: Learn from my correction rather than trying to get silver. \q Knowledge is better than gold.

fr.L: Prenez ma discipline et non l’argent, \q et la connaissance plutôt que l’or de choix.
fr.B: Choisissez ma discipline plutôt que l’argent, \q et la connaissance plutôt que l’or le plus fin.
fr.R: Profitez de ma correction au lieu de chercher à avoir de l’argent. \q La connaissance vaut mieux que l’or.

sw.L: Pokeeni nidhamu yangu wala si fedha, \q na maarifa kuliko dhahabu teule.
sw.B: Chagueni nidhamu yangu badala ya fedha, \q na maarifa kuliko dhahabu iliyo bora.
sw.R: Jifunzeni kutokana na maonyo yangu badala ya kujitahidi kupata fedha. \q Maarifa ni bora kuliko dhahabu.

decisions.choice: and not silver: rather than silver
decisions.reason: "Not silver" means "in preference to silver", as the second line shows.

source.text: כִּֽי־טוֹבָ֣ה חָ֭כְמָה מִפְּנִינִ֑ים וְכָל־חֲ֝פָצִ֗ים לֹ֣א יִֽשְׁווּ־בָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: For better [is] wisdom than corals, and all delights do not compare with her.

en.L: For wisdom [is] better than corals, \q and all delights do not compare with her.
en.B: For wisdom is worth more than red coral; \q nothing you could want comes close to her.
en.R: Wisdom is worth more than jewels. \q Nothing you could want is as good as she is.

fr.L: Car la sagesse [est] meilleure que les coraux, \q et tous les délices ne l’égalent pas.
fr.B: Car la sagesse vaut plus que le corail rouge ; \q rien de ce qu’on pourrait désirer ne se compare à elle.
fr.R: La sagesse vaut plus que des bijoux. \q Rien de ce que tu pourrais vouloir n’est aussi bon qu’elle.

sw.L: Kwa maana hekima [ni] bora kuliko marijani, \q na vitu vyote vipendezavyo havilingani naye.
sw.B: Kwa maana hekima ina thamani kuliko marijani nyekundu; \q hakuna kitu unachoweza kutamani kinachokaribia kuwa kama yeye.
sw.R: Hekima ina thamani kuliko vito. \q Hakuna kitu unachoweza kutaka kilicho bora kama yeye.

decisions.choice: better than corals: as in 3:15
decisions.reason: Wisdom quotes what the father said of her in 3:14–15.

source.text: אֲֽנִי־חָ֭כְמָה שָׁכַ֣נְתִּי עָרְמָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת מְזִמּ֣וֹת אֶמְצָֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: I, wisdom, I dwell [with] prudence, and knowledge of discretion I find.

en.L: I, wisdom, dwell [with] prudence, \q and I find knowledge [and] discretion.
en.B: I, Wisdom, share my home with Prudence, \q and I find knowledge and good planning.
en.R: I am Wisdom. Good sense lives with me, \q and I know how to plan well.

fr.L: Moi, la sagesse, j’habite [avec] la prudence, \q et je trouve la connaissance [et] la réflexion.
fr.B: Moi, la Sagesse, je partage ma demeure avec la Prudence, \q et je trouve la connaissance et l’art de bien prévoir.
fr.R: Je suis la sagesse. Le bon sens habite avec moi, \q et je sais faire de bons projets.

sw.L: Mimi, hekima, ninakaa [pamoja na] werevu, \q nami ninapata maarifa [na] uwezo wa kupanga.
sw.B: Mimi, Hekima, ninaishi nyumba moja na Werevu, \q nami ninapata maarifa na mipango mizuri.
sw.R: Mimi ni Hekima. Busara inakaa pamoja nami, \q nami ninajua jinsi ya kupanga vizuri.

decisions.choice: dwell with prudence: prudence is my neighbor
decisions.reason: Wisdom pictures the virtues as members of her household.

source.text: יִֽרְאַ֣ת יְהוָה֮ שְֽׂנֹ֫את רָ֥ע גֵּ֘אָ֤ה וְגָא֨וֹן׀וְדֶ֣רֶךְ רָ֭ע וּפִ֨י תַהְפֻּכ֬וֹת שָׂנֵֽאתִי׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] fear of YHWH [is] to hate evil; pride and arrogance and [the] way of evil and a mouth of perversities I hate.

en.L: The fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] to hate evil; \q pride and arrogance and [the] way of evil and a perverse mouth I hate.
en.B: To fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is to hate evil. \q Pride, arrogance, evil conduct and twisted talk are what I hate.
en.R: If you honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with awe, you will hate evil. \q I hate pride, people who act as if they are better than others, evil ways and lies.

fr.L: La crainte {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [est] de haïr le mal ; \q l’orgueil et l’arrogance et le chemin du mal et une bouche perverse, je [les] hais.
fr.B: Craindre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, c’est haïr le mal. \q L’orgueil, l’arrogance, la mauvaise conduite et les paroles tordues, voilà ce que je hais.
fr.R: Si tu honores {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avec respect, tu détesteras le mal. \q Je déteste l’orgueil, ceux qui se croient meilleurs que les autres, les mauvaises façons de vivre et les mensonges.

sw.L: Kumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] kuchukia uovu; \q kiburi na majivuno na njia ya uovu na kinywa cha upotovu ninavichukia.
sw.B: Kumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni kuchukia uovu. \q Kiburi, majivuno, mwenendo mbaya na maneno ya upotovu ndivyo ninavyovichukia.
sw.R: Ukimheshimu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa hofu takatifu, utachukia uovu. \q Ninachukia kiburi, watu wanaojiona bora kuliko wengine, njia mbaya na uongo.

decisions.choice: the fear of the LORD is to hate evil
decisions.reason: The fear of the LORD (1:7) is not only reverence but a turning from evil (3:7; 16:6).

decisions.choice: pride and arrogance: two words from one root
decisions.reason: Both words (geah, gaon) come from the root "to rise up".

source.text: לִֽי־עֵ֭צָה וְתוּשִׁיָּ֑ה אֲנִ֥י בִ֝ינָ֗ה לִ֣י גְבוּרָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: To me [are] counsel and sound wisdom; I [am] understanding; to me [is] strength.

en.L: Counsel and sound wisdom [are] mine; \q I [am] understanding; strength [is] mine.
en.B: Counsel and sound judgment belong to me; \q I am Understanding, and I have strength.
en.R: I give good advice and wise ideas. \q I understand things, and I am strong.

fr.L: À moi le conseil et la sagesse efficace ; \q moi, [je suis] l’intelligence ; à moi la force.
fr.B: Le conseil et le bon jugement m’appartiennent ; \q je suis l’Intelligence, et j’ai la force.
fr.R: Je donne de bons conseils et des idées sages. \q Je comprends les choses, et je suis forte.

sw.L: Shauri na hekima iliyo thabiti [ni] yangu; \q mimi [ni] ufahamu; nguvu [ni] zangu.
sw.B: Shauri na busara njema ni mali yangu; \q mimi ni Ufahamu, nami nina nguvu.
sw.R: Mimi hutoa mashauri mema na mawazo ya hekima. \q Ninaelewa mambo, nami nina nguvu.

decisions.choice: counsel ... strength: gifts of the Spirit in Isaiah 11:2
decisions.reason: The same words name the gifts of the Spirit on the coming king: "the spirit of counsel and strength" (Isaiah 11:2). The next verses turn to kings.

source.text: בִּ֭י מְלָכִ֣ים יִמְלֹ֑כוּ וְ֝רוֹזְנִ֗ים יְחֹ֣קְקוּ צֶֽדֶק׃

records.literal_gloss: By me kings reign, and rulers decree righteousness.

en.L: By me kings reign, \q and rulers decree what is right.
en.B: Through me kings rule, \q and rulers make just laws.
en.R: Kings rule well because of me. \q Leaders make fair laws because of me.

fr.L: Par moi les rois règnent, \q et les dirigeants décrètent ce qui est juste.
fr.B: C’est par moi que les rois gouvernent \q et que les dirigeants font des lois justes.
fr.R: Grâce à moi, les rois gouvernent bien. \q Grâce à moi, les chefs font des lois justes.

sw.L: Kwa mimi wafalme hutawala, \q na watawala huamuru yaliyo haki.
sw.B: Kupitia kwangu wafalme hutawala, \q na watawala hutunga sheria za haki.
sw.R: Wafalme hutawala vizuri kwa sababu yangu. \q Viongozi hutunga sheria za haki kwa sababu yangu.

decisions.choice: decree: inscribe laws
decisions.reason: The verb (haqaq) means to engrave, and so to make laws (Isaiah 10:1).

source.text: בִּ֭י שָׂרִ֣ים יָשֹׂ֑רוּ וּ֝נְדִיבִ֗ים כָּל־שֹׁ֥פְטֵי צֶֽדֶק׃

records.literal_gloss: By me princes rule, and nobles, all judges of righteousness.

en.L: By me princes rule, \q and nobles, all [the] judges of righteousness.
en.B: Through me princes govern, \q and nobles, all who judge rightly.
en.R: Princes and other leaders govern well because of me, \q and so do all judges who are fair.

fr.L: Par moi les princes dominent, \q et les nobles, tous les juges de la justice.
fr.B: C’est par moi que les princes commandent, \q et les nobles, tous ceux qui jugent avec justice.
fr.R: Grâce à moi, les princes et les autres chefs dirigent bien, \q et tous les juges qui sont justes aussi.

sw.L: Kwa mimi wakuu hutawala, \q na wakuu wa heshima, waamuzi wote wa haki.
sw.B: Kupitia kwangu wakuu huongoza, \q na watu wenye vyeo, wote wanaohukumu kwa haki.
sw.R: Wakuu na viongozi wengine huongoza vizuri kwa sababu yangu, \q vivyo hivyo waamuzi wote walio wa haki.

decisions.choice: all the judges of righteousness, as the Hebrew text has it
alternatives: all the judges of the earth (many Hebrew manuscripts and ancient translations)
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts and ancient translations read "all the judges of the earth". The two words look alike in Hebrew. The sense is close either way.

source.text: אֲ֭נִי אֹהֲבַ֣י אֵהָ֑ב וּ֝מְשַׁחֲרַ֗י יִמְצָאֻֽנְנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: I those loving me love, and those seeking me earnestly find me.

en.L: I love those who love me, \q and those who seek me eagerly find me.
en.B: Those who love me I love in return, \q and those who search hard for me will find me.
en.R: I love everyone who loves me. \q Those who look hard for me will find me.

fr.L: Moi, j’aime ceux qui m’aiment, \q et ceux qui me cherchent avec ardeur me trouvent.
fr.B: J’aime à mon tour ceux qui m’aiment, \q et ceux qui me cherchent de tout leur cœur me trouveront.
fr.R: J’aime tous ceux qui m’aiment. \q Ceux qui me cherchent avec effort me trouveront.

sw.L: Mimi nawapenda wale wanipendao, \q na wale wanitafutao kwa bidii huniona.
sw.B: Wale wanaonipenda nami nawapenda, \q na wale wanaonitafuta kwa bidii wataniona.
sw.R: Ninampenda kila mtu anayenipenda. \q Wale wanaonitafuta kwa bidii wataniona.

decisions.choice: those who love me, as the scribes' reading has it
alternatives: those who love her (the written form)
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) read "those who love her"; the reading the scribes marked (qere) is "those who love me", which suits Wisdom speaking.

decisions.choice: seek eagerly: the verb of 1:28
decisions.reason: In 1:28 the scornful seek her eagerly too late and do not find her. Here the promise is the other side: those who love her find her.

source.text: עֹֽשֶׁר־וְכָב֥וֹד אִתִּ֑י ה֥וֹן עָ֝תֵ֗ק וּצְדָקָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Wealth and honor [are] with me, enduring wealth and righteousness.

en.L: Wealth and honor [are] with me, \q enduring wealth and righteousness.
en.B: Riches and honor are mine to give, \q lasting wealth and righteousness.
en.R: I give riches and honor. \q I give wealth that lasts, and I help people do what is right.

fr.L: La richesse et l’honneur [sont] avec moi, \q une fortune durable et la justice.
fr.B: J’ai à donner la richesse et l’honneur, \q des biens qui durent et la justice.
fr.R: Je donne la richesse et l’honneur. \q Je donne des biens qui durent, et j’aide les gens à faire ce qui est juste.

sw.L: Mali na heshima [ziko] kwangu, \q mali idumuyo na haki.
sw.B: Utajiri na heshima ni vyangu kuvitoa, \q mali ya kudumu na haki.
sw.R: Mimi hutoa utajiri na heshima. \q Hutoa mali inayodumu, na huwasaidia watu kutenda yaliyo sawa.

decisions.choice: righteousness: right standing, and the prosperity it brings
decisions.reason: Beside wealth, righteousness (tsedaqah) may include the well-being that comes from being right with God and neighbor (21:21).

source.text: ט֣וֹב פִּ֭רְיִי מֵחָר֣וּץ וּמִפָּ֑ז וּ֝תְבוּאָתִ֗י מִכֶּ֥סֶף נִבְחָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Better [is] my fruit than gold and than fine gold, and my yield than chosen silver.

en.L: My fruit [is] better than gold, even fine gold, \q and my yield than choice silver.
en.B: What I produce is better than gold, the purest gold, \q and what I yield beats the finest silver.
en.R: What I give you is better than the purest gold \q and the finest silver.

fr.L: Mon fruit [est] meilleur que l’or, même que l’or fin, \q et mon produit que l’argent de choix.
fr.B: Ce que je produis vaut mieux que l’or, que l’or le plus pur, \q et ce que je rapporte dépasse l’argent le plus fin.
fr.R: Ce que je te donne vaut mieux que l’or le plus pur \q et que l’argent le plus fin.

sw.L: Tunda langu [ni] bora kuliko dhahabu, hata dhahabu safi, \q na mazao yangu kuliko fedha teule.
sw.B: Ninachozaa ni bora kuliko dhahabu, dhahabu iliyo safi kabisa, \q na mavuno yangu yanazidi fedha iliyo bora.
sw.R: Ninachokupa ni bora kuliko dhahabu safi kabisa \q na fedha iliyo bora.

decisions.choice: fine gold: refined gold
decisions.reason: The word (paz) is gold of the highest purity (Song of Songs 5:11).

source.text: בְּאֹֽרַח־צְדָקָ֥ה אֲהַלֵּ֑ךבְּ֝ת֗וֹךְ נְתִיב֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

records.literal_gloss: In [the] path of righteousness I walk, in [the] midst of [the] paths of justice,

en.L: I walk in [the] path of righteousness, \q in [the] midst of [the] paths of justice,
en.B: I walk on the road of righteousness, \q right along the paths of justice,
en.R: I always do what is right and fair.

fr.L: Je marche dans le sentier de la justice, \q au milieu des sentiers du droit,
fr.B: Je marche sur la route de la justice, \q au beau milieu des sentiers du droit,
fr.R: Je fais toujours ce qui est juste et équitable.

sw.L: Natembea katika njia ya haki, \q katikati ya mapito ya hukumu ya haki,
sw.B: Natembea katika barabara ya haki, \q sawasawa katika mapito ya uadilifu,
sw.R: Siku zote mimi hutenda yaliyo sawa na ya haki.

decisions.choice: I walk in the path: my way of life
decisions.reason: Wisdom keeps to the paths she urges on others (2:20; 4:11).

source.text: לְהַנְחִ֖יל אֹהֲבַ֥י׀יֵ֑שׁ וְאֹצְרֹ֖תֵיהֶ֣ם אֲמַלֵּֽא׃פ

records.literal_gloss: to make those loving me inherit substance, and their treasuries I fill.

en.L: to give those who love me an inheritance of substance, \q and I fill their treasuries.
en.B: giving those who love me real wealth as their inheritance \q and filling their storehouses.
en.R: I give real riches to people who love me. \q I fill their homes with treasure.

fr.L: pour faire hériter à ceux qui m’aiment ce qui est réel, \q et je remplis leurs trésors.
fr.B: pour donner en héritage de vrais biens à ceux qui m’aiment \q et pour remplir leurs réserves.
fr.R: Je donne de vraies richesses à ceux qui m’aiment. \q Je remplis leurs maisons de trésors.

sw.L: ili kuwarithisha wale wanipendao mali ya kweli, \q nami huzijaza hazina zao.
sw.B: nikiwapa wale wanaonipenda mali halisi kuwa urithi wao \q na kuzijaza ghala zao.
sw.R: Huwapa utajiri wa kweli watu wanaonipenda. \q Hujaza nyumba zao hazina.

decisions.choice: substance: what truly exists, real wealth
decisions.reason: The word (yesh) means "there is": what is real and lasting, unlike the gang's plunder (1:13).

source.text: יְֽהוָ֗ה קָ֭נָנִי רֵאשִׁ֣ית דַּרְכּ֑וֹ קֶ֖דֶם מִפְעָלָ֣יו מֵאָֽז׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH created me [as the] beginning of his way, before his works from of old.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} possessed me [at the] beginning of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} way, \q before {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} works of old.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} brought me into being as the first of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ways, \q before {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} works of long ago.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} made me first, before {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made anything else, long ago.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a acquise [au] commencement de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} chemin, \q avant {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} œuvres d’autrefois.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a formée comme la première de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} œuvres, \q avant {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} actions d’autrefois.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a faite en premier, il y a très longtemps, avant de faire quoi que ce soit d’autre.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinimiliki mwanzoni mwa njia {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \q kabla ya kazi {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} za kale.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliniumba niwe wa kwanza wa njia {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, \q kabla ya kazi {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} za zamani.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliniumba kwanza, kabla hajaumba kitu kingine chochote, zamani za kale.

decisions.choice: possessed / brought into being: the LORD had wisdom from the start
decisions.reason: The verb (qanah) usually means to get or acquire (4:5, 7), but it also means to create or bring into being (Genesis 14:19, 22; Deuteronomy 32:6). Ancient translations divided: the Greek has "created", others "possessed". The point of the poem is that wisdom was with the LORD before the world began. Early Christians, reading Wisdom as a picture of Christ, argued over this verse.

decisions.choice: the beginning of his way: the first of his works
alternatives: at the beginning of his way
decisions.reason: The word (reshit) as in 1:7 and Genesis 1:1. Wisdom came first.

decisions.choice: possessed
decisions.reason: Literal uses "possessed", the usual sense of the verb; Balanced and Readable say "brought into being" and "made", from the context of birth (verses 24–25). See m1.

decisions.choice: "m'a acquise" at Literal
decisions.reason: The English Literal says "possessed" (meaning decision m1: the LORD had wisdom from the start). In French "possédée" suggests being possessed by a spirit, so Literal uses "acquise", which keeps the sense of having and getting. Balanced "m'a formée" follows the English Balanced "brought me into being".

decisions.choice: Wisdom speaks of herself in the feminine ("acquise", "formée", "née", "établie")
decisions.reason: Wisdom is a woman in the Hebrew, and French past participles must agree with the speaker, so her account of her birth (verses 22–31) is in the feminine.

decisions.choice: "alinimiliki" (possessed me) at Literal; "aliniumba" (created me) at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Swahili follows the English levels: Literal keeps "possessed", Balanced and Readable say that the LORD brought Wisdom into being (meaning decision m1).

source.text: מֵ֭עוֹלָם נִסַּ֥כְתִּי מֵרֹ֗אשׁ מִקַּדְמֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: From of old I was installed, from [the] first, from [the] beginnings of [the] earth.

en.L: From of old I was set up, from [the] first, \q from [the] beginnings of [the] earth.
en.B: Long ages ago I was set in place, at the very first, \q before the earth began.
en.R: I was there long ago, at the very beginning, before the earth was made.

fr.L: Dès l’éternité j’ai été établie, dès le commencement, \q dès les origines de la terre.
fr.B: Il y a des âges j’ai été mise en place, tout au début, \q avant que la terre ne commence.
fr.R: J’étais là il y a très longtemps, au tout début, avant que la terre soit faite.

sw.L: Tangu kale niliwekwa, tangu mwanzo, \q tangu mwanzo wa dunia.
sw.B: Zamani za kale niliwekwa mahali pangu, mwanzo kabisa, \q kabla dunia haijaanza.
sw.R: Nilikuwepo zamani sana, mwanzo kabisa, kabla dunia haijaumbwa.

decisions.choice: set up: installed, or woven
decisions.reason: The verb (nissakti) may mean "installed", as a king is (Psalm 2:6), or "woven", as a child in the womb (Psalm 139:13, with a related verb).

source.text: בְּאֵין־תְּהֹמ֥וֹת חוֹלָ֑לְתִּי בְּאֵ֥ין מַ֝עְיָנ֗וֹת נִכְבַּדֵּי־מָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: When there were no deeps I was brought forth, when there were no springs heavy with water.

en.L: When [there were] no deeps, I was brought forth, \q when [there were] no springs heavy with water.
en.B: Before there were any oceans I was born, \q before there were springs full of water.
en.R: I was born before there were any oceans or springs of water.

fr.L: Quand [il n’y avait] pas d’abîmes, je suis née, \q quand [il n’y avait] pas de sources chargées d’eau.
fr.B: Avant qu’il y ait des océans, je suis née, \q avant qu’il y ait des sources pleines d’eau.
fr.R: Je suis née avant qu’il y ait des océans ou des sources d’eau.

sw.L: Wakati [kulipokuwa] hakuna vilindi, nilizaliwa, \q wakati [kulipokuwa] hakuna chemchemi zilizojaa maji.
sw.B: Kabla bahari hazijakuwapo nilizaliwa, \q kabla chemchemi zilizojaa maji hazijakuwapo.
sw.R: Nilizaliwa kabla hakujawa na bahari wala chemchemi za maji.

decisions.choice: brought forth: born
decisions.reason: The verb (holal) is used of giving birth (Psalm 51:7; Job 15:7). Wisdom speaks of her origin as a birth before the world.

source.text: בְּטֶ֣רֶם הָרִ֣ים הָטְבָּ֑עוּ לִפְנֵ֖י גְבָע֣וֹת חוֹלָֽלְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: Before mountains were sunk, before hills, I was brought forth,

en.L: Before [the] mountains were settled, \q before [the] hills, I was brought forth,
en.B: Before the mountains were set on their foundations, \q before the hills, I was born,
en.R: I was born before the mountains and hills were made,

fr.L: Avant que les montagnes soient enfoncées, \q avant les collines, je suis née,
fr.B: Avant que les montagnes soient posées sur leurs fondations, \q avant les collines, je suis née,
fr.R: Je suis née avant que les montagnes et les collines soient faites,

sw.L: Kabla milima haijakazwa, \q kabla ya vilima, nilizaliwa,
sw.B: Kabla milima haijawekwa juu ya misingi yake, \q kabla ya vilima, nilizaliwa,
sw.R: Nilizaliwa kabla milima na vilima havijaumbwa,

decisions.choice: settled: sunk in place
decisions.reason: The verb (taba) is used of sinking something down, like the pillars of the earth (Job 38:6).

source.text: עַד־לֹ֣א עָ֭שָׂה אֶ֣רֶץ וְחוּצ֑וֹת וְ֝רֹ֗אשׁ עָפְר֥וֹתתֵּבֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: while he had not made [the] earth and open fields, and [the] first of [the] dusts of [the] world.

en.L: while {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had not yet made [the] earth and [the] open fields, \q or [the] first of [the] dust of [the] world.
en.B: before {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had made the land and the open country, \q or the first specks of the world's soil.
en.R: before {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made the land and the fields \q and the first dirt of the earth.

fr.L: alors qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’avait pas encore fait la terre et les campagnes, \q ni le premier de la poussière du monde.
fr.B: avant qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ait fait la terre et les grands espaces, \q ni les premiers grains de la poussière du monde.
fr.R: avant qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fasse la terre et les champs \q et la première poussière du sol.

sw.L: alipokuwa bado hajaifanya dunia wala mashamba, \q wala mwanzo wa mavumbi ya ulimwengu.
sw.B: kabla hajaifanya nchi na mbuga, \q wala chembe za kwanza za udongo wa ulimwengu.
sw.R: kabla hajaifanya nchi na mashamba \q na udongo wa kwanza wa dunia.

decisions.choice: open fields ... dust: the land outside the towns and its soil
decisions.reason: The word (hutsot) is the open country; the dust (aphar) the soil from which man was made (Genesis 2:7).

source.text: בַּהֲכִינ֣וֹ שָׁ֭מַיִם שָׁ֣ם אָ֑נִי בְּח֥וּקוֹ ח֝֗וּג עַל־פְּנֵ֥י תְהֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: When he established [the] heavens, there [was] I; when he marked a circle on [the] face of [the] deep,

en.L: When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} established [the] heavens, I [was] there; \q when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} marked out a circle on [the] face of [the] deep,
en.B: I was there when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} set the heavens in place, \q when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} drew a circle on the face of the deep,
en.R: I was there when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} put the sky in place. \q I was there when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} marked where the sea ends and the sky begins.

fr.L: Quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a affermi les cieux, j’[étais] là ; \q quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a tracé un cercle sur la face de l’abîme,
fr.B: J’étais là quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a mis les cieux en place, \q quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a tracé un cercle à la surface de l’abîme,
fr.R: J’étais là quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a mis le ciel en place. \q J’étais là quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a marqué l’endroit où la mer s’arrête et où le ciel commence.

sw.L: Alipozithibitisha mbingu, mimi [nilikuwa] pale; \q alipochora duara juu ya uso wa kilindi,
sw.B: Nilikuwepo alipoziweka mbingu mahali pake, \q alipochora duara juu ya uso wa kilindi,
sw.R: Nilikuwepo alipoiweka anga mahali pake. \q Nilikuwepo alipoweka alama ya mahali bahari inapoishia na anga inapoanzia.

decisions.choice: a circle on the face of the deep: the horizon
decisions.reason: The circle (hug) is the horizon, where the sky seems to rest on the waters (Job 26:10; Isaiah 40:22).

decisions.choice: the creation told in the passé composé at every level ("il a affermi", "il a tracé")
alternatives: the passé simple of written narrative at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: Wisdom is speaking, and the style guide keeps the tenses of speech for a story told inside speech; the passé composé also matches "je suis née" in verses 24–25.

source.text: בְּאַמְּצ֣וֹ שְׁחָקִ֣ים מִמָּ֑עַל בַּ֝עֲז֗וֹז עִינ֥וֹת תְּהוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: when he made firm [the] clouds above, when [the] springs of [the] deep grew strong,

en.L: when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made firm [the] clouds above, \q when [the] springs of [the] deep grew strong,
en.B: when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} fixed the clouds overhead \q and made the springs of the deep flow strong,
en.R: I was there when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} put the clouds in the sky \q and made the springs flow from deep in the earth.

fr.L: quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a rendu fermes les nuages en haut, \q quand les sources de l’abîme sont devenues fortes,
fr.B: quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fixé les nuages là-haut \q et fait jaillir avec force les sources de l’abîme,
fr.R: J’étais là quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a mis les nuages dans le ciel \q et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait couler les sources du fond de la terre.

sw.L: alipoyaimarisha mawingu juu, \q chemchemi za kilindi zilipopata nguvu,
sw.B: alipoyaweka mawingu juu angani \q na kuzifanya chemchemi za kilindi zibubujike kwa nguvu,
sw.R: Nilikuwepo alipoyaweka mawingu angani \q na kuzifanya chemchemi zibubujike kutoka ndani ya ardhi.

decisions.choice: grew strong: the springs were made secure
decisions.reason: The form may be read "when he made the springs strong". Either way, God set the deep waters in order.

source.text: בְּשׂ֘וּמ֤וֹ לַיָּ֨ם׀חֻקּ֗וֹ וּ֭מַיִם לֹ֣א יַֽעַבְרוּ־פִ֑יו בְּ֝חוּק֗וֹ מ֣וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: when he set for the sea its limit, and [the] waters would not pass his mouth, when he marked out [the] foundations of [the] earth,

en.L: when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} set for the sea its limit, \q so that [the] waters would not pass {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} command, \q when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} marked out [the] foundations of [the] earth,
en.B: when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave the sea its boundary \q so that the waters would not go beyond {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} command, \q when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} laid out the foundations of the earth,
en.R: I was there when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} told the sea how far it could go, and the water obeyed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q I was there when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} laid the foundations of the earth.

fr.L: quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fixé à la mer sa limite, \q pour que les eaux ne passent pas outre à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} ordre, \q quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a tracé les fondements de la terre,
fr.B: quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a donné à la mer sa frontière \q pour que les eaux n’aillent pas au-delà de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} ordre, \q quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dessiné les fondations de la terre,
fr.R: J’étais là quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dit à la mer jusqu’où elle pouvait aller, et l’eau {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a obéi. \q J’étais là quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a posé les fondations de la terre.

sw.L: alipoiwekea bahari mpaka wake, \q ili maji yasivuke agizo {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, \q alipoichora misingi ya dunia,
sw.B: alipoipa bahari mpaka wake \q ili maji yasipite zaidi ya agizo {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, \q alipoipanga misingi ya dunia,
sw.R: Nilikuwepo alipoiambia bahari mwisho wake, na maji yakamtii. \q Nilikuwepo alipoiweka misingi ya dunia.

decisions.choice: his mouth: his command
decisions.reason: The waters do not cross what God said (Job 38:8–11; Psalm 104:9; Jeremiah 5:22).

source.text: וָֽאֶהְיֶ֥ה אֶצְל֗וֹ אָ֫מ֥וֹן וָֽאֶהְיֶ֣ה שַׁ֭עֲשֻׁעִים י֤וֹם׀י֑וֹם מְשַׂחֶ֖קֶת לְפָנָ֣יו בְּכָל־עֵֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: and I was beside him [as] a craftsman, and I was delight[s] day [by] day, playing before him at every time,

en.L: then I was beside {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} [as] a master craftsman, \q and I was [{{deity_pronoun:his|His}}] delight day by day, \q rejoicing before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} at all times,
en.B: I was right beside {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, a master worker, \q and I was {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} delight day after day, \q always at play in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence,
en.R: I was beside {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} like a skilled worker. \q Every day {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was happy with me, and I was always happy with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: alors j’étais auprès de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} [comme] maître d’œuvre, \q et j’étais [{{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}}] délices jour après jour, \q me réjouissant devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} en tout temps,
fr.B: J’étais tout près de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, comme une maîtresse d’œuvre, \q et je faisais {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} délices jour après jour, \q jouant sans cesse en {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} présence,
fr.R: J’étais à côté de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, comme une ouvrière habile. \q Chaque jour, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était heureux avec moi, et j’étais toujours heureuse avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: ndipo nilikuwa kando {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} [kama] fundi stadi, \q nami nilikuwa furaha [{{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}] siku kwa siku, \q nikifurahi mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kila wakati,
sw.B: Nilikuwa karibu {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}, fundi mkuu, \q nami nilikuwa furaha {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} siku baada ya siku, \q nikicheza mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} siku zote,
sw.R: Nilikuwa kando {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kama fundi stadi. \q Kila siku alifurahi nami, nami nilifurahi {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} siku zote.

decisions.choice: craftsman: a master worker
decisions.reason: The word (amon) may mean a master craftsman (Jeremiah 52:15; Song of Songs 7:1, related). With other vowels it reads "a nursling", a child, which fits the birth words of verses 24–25 and the playing of verses 30–31. Both readings are old. The verse shows Wisdom at God's side as he made all things.

decisions.choice: delight ... rejoicing: joyful play
decisions.reason: The second word (mesaheqet) means laughing or playing, as children play (Zechariah 8:5). Wisdom delights in God's work, and he in her.

decisions.choice: delight: his delight, or delighting
alternatives: I was delighted day by day
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "I was delights", which may mean his delight in her or her delight in him; the next line suggests both.

source.text: מְ֭שַׂחֶקֶת בְּתֵבֵ֣ל אַרְצ֑וֹ וְ֝שַׁעֲשֻׁעַ֗י אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: playing in [the] world of his earth, and my delights [were] with [the] sons of humankind.

en.L: rejoicing in [the] world, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} earth, \q and my delight [was] with [the] {{gender:children|sons}} of humankind.
en.B: playing over the whole world {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had made, \q and delighting in the human race.
en.R: I enjoyed the world {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made, \q and I loved the people in it.

fr.L: me réjouissant dans le monde, {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} terre, \q et mes délices [étaient] avec les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de l’humanité.
fr.B: jouant sur toute la terre qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait faite, \q et trouvant ma joie dans le genre humain.
fr.R: J’aimais le monde qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait, \q et j’aimais les gens qui l’habitent.

sw.L: nikifurahi katika ulimwengu, dunia {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \q na furaha yangu [ilikuwa] pamoja na wanadamu.
sw.B: nikicheza katika ulimwengu wote alioufanya, \q na kuwafurahia wanadamu.
sw.R: Niliufurahia ulimwengu alioufanya, \q nami niliwapenda watu walio ndani yake.

decisions.choice: the sons of humankind: people
decisions.reason: The phrase of verse 4: Wisdom delights in people, and so she calls them.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִ֑י וְ֝אַשְׁרֵ֗י דְּרָכַ֥י יִשְׁמֹֽרוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, sons, listen to me, and how blessed [are those who] keep my ways.

en.L: And now, {{gender:children|sons}}, listen to me: \q how blessed [are those who] keep my ways.
en.B: So now, {{gender:children|sons}}, listen to me: \q how blessed are those who keep to my ways!
en.R: So listen to me, children. \q People who live my way are truly happy.

fr.L: Et maintenant, {{gender:enfants|fils}}, écoutez-moi : \q heureux [ceux qui] gardent mes chemins.
fr.B: Maintenant donc, mes {{gender:enfants|fils}}, écoutez-moi : \q heureux ceux qui suivent mes chemins !
fr.R: Alors écoutez-moi, mes enfants. \q Ceux qui vivent comme je l’enseigne sont vraiment heureux.

sw.L: Basi sasa, enyi wana, nisikilizeni: \q heri [wale] wazishikao njia zangu.
sw.B: Basi sasa, wana, nisikilizeni: \q heri wale wanaodumu katika njia zangu!
sw.R: Basi nisikilizeni, wanangu. \q Watu wanaoishi kwa njia yangu wana furaha kweli.

decisions.choice: sons: here Wisdom's children, all who hear her
decisions.reason: In the father's mouth "sons" means his own sons (4:1). Wisdom has called all people (verse 4), so here the word includes everyone who will listen.

decisions.choice: gender setting: children (default) or sons
decisions.reason: Because Wisdom speaks to all people (m1), the inclusive word is the default here, unlike the father's "sons" in 4:1, 5:7 and 7:24.

source.text: שִׁמְע֖וּ מוּסָ֥ר וַחֲכָ֗מוּ וְאַל־תִּפְרָֽעוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Listen to discipline and be wise, and do not neglect [it].

en.L: Listen to discipline and be wise, and do not neglect [it].
en.B: Listen to correction and become wise; do not brush it aside.
en.R: Listen when you are corrected, and become wise. \q Do not ignore correction.

fr.L: Écoutez la discipline et soyez sages, et ne [la] négligez pas.
fr.B: Écoutez la correction et devenez sages ; ne la rejetez pas.
fr.R: Écoutez quand on vous corrige, et devenez sages. \q Ne négligez pas la correction.

sw.L: Sikieni nidhamu mwe na hekima, wala msiipuuze.
sw.B: Sikilizeni maonyo mpate hekima; msiyaweke kando.
sw.R: Sikilizeni mnapoonywa, mpate hekima. \q Msipuuze maonyo.

decisions.choice: neglect: let go, ignore
decisions.reason: The verb (para) of 1:25, where the scornful "neglected all my counsel".

source.text: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי אָדָם֮ שֹׁמֵ֪עַֽ֫ לִ֥י לִשְׁקֹ֣ד עַל־דַּ֭לְתֹתַי י֤וֹם׀י֑וֹם לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר מְזוּזֹ֥ת פְּתָחָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: How blessed [is the] person listening to me, keeping watch at my doors day [by] day, guarding [the] posts of my doorways.

en.L: How blessed [is the] person who listens to me, \q watching at my doors day by day, \q waiting at the posts of my doorways.
en.B: How blessed is the one who hears me, \q who keeps watch at my doors every day \q and waits by my doorposts.
en.R: People who listen to me are truly happy. \q Every day they wait at my door, ready to hear me.

fr.L: Heureux l’humain qui m’écoute, \q veillant à mes portes jour après jour, \q gardant les montants de mes portes.
fr.B: Heureux celui qui m’écoute, \q qui veille chaque jour à mes portes \q et attend près de mes montants de porte.
fr.R: Ceux qui m’écoutent sont vraiment heureux. \q Chaque jour, ils attendent à ma porte, prêts à m’entendre.

sw.L: Heri mtu anisikilizaye, \q akikesha kwenye milango yangu siku kwa siku, \q akingoja kwenye miimo ya milango yangu.
sw.B: Heri yule anayenisikia, \q anayekesha kwenye milango yangu kila siku \q na kungoja karibu na miimo ya milango yangu.
sw.R: Watu wanaonisikiliza wana furaha kweli. \q Kila siku hungoja mlangoni pangu, tayari kunisikia.

decisions.choice: watching at my doors: waiting eagerly to be let in
decisions.reason: The picture is of someone waiting at the door of a teacher or a beloved, set against the young man at the strange woman's door (7:8).

source.text: כִּ֣י מֹ֭צְאִי מָצָ֣אחַיִּ֑ים וַיָּ֥פֶק רָ֝צ֗וֹן מֵיְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For [one] finding me finds life and obtains favor from YHWH.

en.L: For whoever finds me finds life \q and obtains favor from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: For the one who finds me has found life \q and wins the favor of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Whoever finds me finds life, \q and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is pleased with them.

fr.L: Car celui qui me trouve trouve la vie \q et obtient la faveur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Car celui qui me trouve a trouvé la vie \q et gagne la faveur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Celui qui me trouve trouve la vie, \q et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est content de lui.

sw.L: Kwa maana yeyote anipataye apata uzima \q na kupata kibali kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Kwa maana anayenipata amepata uzima \q na kupata kibali cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kila anayenipata hupata uzima, \q na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hupendezwa naye.

decisions.choice: finds, as the scribes' reading has it
alternatives: those who find me find (the written form)
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) read "those who find me" (plural); the reading the scribes marked (qere) is singular. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: favor: goodwill, acceptance
decisions.reason: The word (ratson) is God's pleasure in a person (12:2; 18:22).

source.text: וְֽ֭חֹטְאִי חֹמֵ֣ס נַפְשׁ֑וֹ כָּל־מְ֝שַׂנְאַ֗י אָ֣הֲבוּ מָֽוֶת׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And [one] missing me does violence [to] his self; all those hating me love death.

en.L: But whoever misses me wrongs {{gender:their|his}} own self; \q all who hate me love death."
en.B: But whoever fails to find me does violence to their own life; \q all who hate me are in love with death."
en.R: But people who refuse me hurt themselves. \q Everyone who hates me loves death."

fr.L: Mais celui qui me manque fait tort à sa propre personne ; \q tous ceux qui me haïssent aiment la mort. »
fr.B: Mais celui qui ne me trouve pas fait violence à sa propre vie ; \q tous ceux qui me haïssent sont amoureux de la mort. »
fr.R: Mais ceux qui me refusent se font du mal à eux-mêmes. \q Tous ceux qui me détestent aiment la mort. »

sw.L: Lakini anikosaye hujidhulumu nafsi yake mwenyewe; \q wote wanichukiao hupenda mauti."
sw.B: Lakini yeyote asiyenipata hujidhuru maisha yake mwenyewe; \q wote wanaonichukia wanapenda mauti."
sw.R: Lakini watu wanaonikataa hujiumiza wenyewe. \q Kila anayenichukia anapenda kifo."

decisions.choice: misses me: fails to find me, or sins against me
decisions.reason: The verb (hata) means to miss a mark, and so also to sin. Set against "finds me" in verse 35, it means missing her; the word for sin is not far off.

decisions.choice: love death: choose what leads to death
decisions.reason: No one loves death as such; but to hate Wisdom is to choose the road that ends there (7:27).
